pairs.summary: NFATC4 and Prdm5 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 8 of 14 profiles analysed (DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; MDA-MB-468 triple-negative breast cancer; ...). Median lift 1.3x, typical spacing ~50 bp between sites. In 8 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
